name: Structure Chart (Tree)
summary: Legal-entity or group structure from an (id, parent) table — entity boxes by type, orthogonal connectors with ownership %, collapse / expand, zoom; top-down, left-to-right or radial.
summary_zh: 由 (id, parent) 表生成的法律实体 / 集团结构图：按实体类型着色的方框、带持股比例的直角连线、可折叠展开与缩放；支持自上而下、从左到右与放射状布局。
description_zh: 每行数据是一个实体：id、上级 parent（最终母公司为空）、名称、注册国家、上级对其的直接持股比例和实体类型。组件计算紧凑的树形布局，方框内显示实体名称与国家，颜色区分上市母公司 / 控股公司 / 运营子公司 / 合资企业等，持股比例标注在每条下行连线上，低于 50% 的少数股权可用虚线表示；悬停显示直接与穿透（有效）持股比例。点击方框折叠或展开其下属实体，Ctrl/⌘ + 滚轮或双指捏合缩放（普通滚轮照常滚动页面），拖动平移。适用于交易结构图、集团法律实体图、组织架构和分部层级，15–80 个节点为宜。
best_for: Legal entity structure / group chart in a deal or financing
avoid_when: More than ~120 visible entities (start collapsed with initialDepth)
Networks with multiple parents per entity (use network)

parent.desc: Parent entity id; empty / null for the ultimate parent

name.desc: Entity name (wrapped to two lines in the box)

pct.desc: Direct ownership by the parent (0–1) — label on the connector

layout.desc: orthogonal (boxes + right-angle connectors; when a block is too narrow for a wide row of leaf entities they become a compact list of 2–4 columns with ownership on the country line) | radial (dendrogram: root in the centre, leaves on the outer ring, elbow links that never cross branches)

pctLabels.desc: Ownership labels on connectors: all | partial (only below 100%) | false

initialDepth.desc: Collapse entities at this depth and deeper on first render (null = fully expanded)

collapsible.desc: Click an entity (or its '+n' badge) to collapse / expand its subsidiaries

highlight.desc: Entity id(s) or name(s) ringed in accent2 (e.g. the issuer or the entity being sold); the box keeps its entity-type colour and the legend gains a 'Highlighted' key

balance.desc: Order siblings so subtrees with children sit in the middle (parents end up over the centre of the chart); false keeps data order

categoryColors.desc: {entity type: colour} — theme token ('accent', 'cat3' …) or CSS colour

rootFilled.desc: Draw the ultimate parent(s) as a solid box

boxWidth.desc: Box width in px; null fits the container (96–196 TB, 120–200 LR). Names wrap to 2–3 lines at 11px instead of being cut

roam.desc: Zoom (Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch) and drag to pan

wheelZoom.desc: true: zoom on a plain mouse wheel; default: a plain wheel scrolls the page and a hint shows the Ctrl/⌘ + wheel shortcut

format.desc: Ownership format; defaults to the pct field's format

interactions: Hover an entity: country, type, parent, direct and effective (look-through) ownership
Click an entity or its '+n' badge to collapse / expand (animated re-layout)
Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom; drag to pan (plain wheel scrolls the page and shows a hint)
